full_judgment: 2. Facts in short that the plaintiffs purchased the lands in suit in Chaitra, 1364 B.S. appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 386. After their purchase the plaintiffs grew crops therein but the defendant dispossessed them by cutting and taking away the aman paddy grown by them. Hence this suit.
